hints.title: Use a gap
hints.body: If one pointer is `n` nodes ahead of another, the trailing pointer will be just before the node to remove when the leading pointer reaches the end.

hints.title: A dummy node removes special cases
hints.body: Placing an extra node before the head means every removal, including removing the original head, has a predecessor.

hints.title: Advance the lead by n + 1
hints.body: Start both pointers at the dummy. Move the leading pointer `n + 1` steps, then move both until the leader falls off the end. The trailing pointer is then immediately before the target.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
dummy = new node pointing to head
lead = dummy
trail = dummy
repeat n + 1 times: lead = lead.next
while lead is not null:
    lead = lead.next
    trail = trail.next
trail.next = trail.next.next
return dummy.next
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
